First time I played there, I had no problems. It was a twosome with my dad and it was a quick round.

Second time was with my friends who were just picking up golf and the marshall gave us a bit of a hard time for being slow but whatever, we were slow and we tried our best to keep it up. I wasn't happy, but I wasn't going to argue as I thought it was our group's fault.

Third time I played, I went with my work buddies and it was a group of 8 split into two foursomes. If I recall correctly, it was a weekend, so it was a busy day. We were having fun and enjoying our day playing golf, then the marshall came to us around the 5th hole and told us that we were extremely behind schedule and that we needed to keep our pace up. Every time since then he kept following us and watched me swing and constantly said we were late. It was extremely irritating that this guy would just keep staring at me play golf and annoy me, it was like he was deliberately trying to throw me off.

We stopped after the 9th to grab a hotdog and we were only about 5 minutes behind schedule (and we couldn't even see the group of four behind us, which were our own friends) but he kept going on even after that and told us to pick it up. By the 13th or 14th we caught up to the group ahead of us and there were like 3 or 4 groups waiting. We ended up waiting at that hole for about 30 minutes.

After the round all 8 of us were talking and I told my boss at the time about what happened and he went inside and complained about the issue. Turns out, the guy came to our store before and asked for a discount to which we said no. So I don't know if he was trying to take it out on us or not, but he knew we were from my work as we were getting the industry rate at the time.

Ever since then, as the nature of my work I'd talk to customers about good courses around a city in the Pacific Northwest and some people were saying things like how the course is in great condition, people who work there are really nice, but some old marshalls are doing a terrible job of taking care of things.

I never went back to that course after that and then eventually left the city for school. I still tell people it is a great course, and I'm sure things have changed since the last time I went there, but I don't plan on going back anytime soon.

Edit: Sorry for the long rant. I just was typing along and didn't realize it got so long.

How did you know about the game?

* I knew about it for a while, just from seeing it in the media and so on. Just never really got into it until the animated series started.

Why did you start playing the game?

* Eh, when I heard about it a year or so ago, I was always interested in playing, then I saw that it was only available in Japan, so I never really bothered. Then I was running out of games to play and figured I'd give this a try as the animated series started.

How long have you been playing the game?

* Literally started the day after the animated series started, so January this year?

How long do you play the game in a day?

* Ehh, not often. Just to check expeditions and I'll do random grinds once in a while. School takes priority over everything. Since school is done for the year now, I've been grinding hard because I'll be traveling for the next month or so.

How long will you play this game?

* This is a weird question. Until I get bored of this game, and I don't see that happening anytime soon.

If you get banned, will you play again?

* Probably, although I'd be quite upset if it happened.

Who did you pick at the start?

* Inazuma.

What is your goal for the game?

* To be honest, there isn't one. I just want to be able to level a lot of ships and get many of them to their upgraded forms and so on.

Do you have all ship characters?

* God, I wish. I don't think I'll ever reach that point.

Have you finished all worlds?

* No. Still in world 5. Taking my time.

What is your favorite and least favorite map?

* Favorite is probably 3-2 because I get to level ships there. As for least favorite? 2-4. I was stuck there forever. The random number generator hated me.

What class is your favorite?

* Definitely battleships. Love seeing them wreak havoc. Probably after them are destroyers. The feeling when you see them crit in night battles and deal tons of damage excites me.

Who is your favorite character?

* Ro-chan (sadly I don't have her), Haruna. I'm in love with Kako's new upgraded form, so I started leveling her from yesterday. She's at level 62 now. 3 levels to go!

Who is your highest level character?

* Level 98 Haruna. I've focused on making my ships level evenly high, so the only time I try to level up my Haruna is during player versus player battles.

Who do you want to see added to the game or get an upgrade?

* Uh... Takao/Atago, Shimakaze/Yukikaze, and maybe Yamato/Musashi?

Favorite enemy?

* None.

Do you play with other related merchandise? Buy things?

* I collect some figurines, but that's about it.

Have you spent money on the game?

* Yeah, like 50 bucks I think?

Do you know the language?

* My parent's business back home deals often with companies from that country, so I know how to speak a little bit, but that's about it. Can't write and stuff though.

Do you use a specific tool or the other one?

* I use a specific tool. The browser extension makes things easier, and also I own two computers (a desktop at home and a laptop for lectures), and it makes it easy to go back and forth.
